in_marathi.name: Pranika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, Intention, Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pran', meaning life, and 'Nidhi', meaning wish or intention. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Pranika represents the desire or intention that nurtures and sustains life. Pranika is often used as a name for a girl who is believed to embody the power of life and the desire to live.
